contexts.text: To dream = to predict future things; for prophetic dreams were predictions of things to come... In the supreme sense, they = foresight; for predictions are from the Lord's Divine foresight. That this is the only source of predictions about Things which do not flow according to the common order of nature, and which therefore cannot be foreseen. Illustrated.
Others... studied natural magic, whereby nothing of what is Divine could be predicted; but only what is contrary to the Divine...
A dream = foresight, and the derivative prediction...
